reference: He had been waiting for two hours before his number finally appeared.
sk: Čakal dve hodiny, kým sa konečne objavilo jeho číslo.
cz: Čekal dvě hodiny, než se konečně objevilo jeho číslo.
acceptable: He had been waiting {for |}two hours {before|until} his number {finally appeared|appeared at last|finally came up|finally showed up}.
For two hours he had been waiting {before|until} his number finally appeared.

mistakes.text: He was waiting for two hours {before|until} his number finally appeared.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Čakanie trvalo až do iného minulého deja, preto Past Perfect Continuous: „had been waiting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Čekání trvalo až do jiného minulého děje, proto Past Perfect Continuous: „had been waiting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The waiting lasted up to another past event, so use the Past Perfect Continuous: “had been waiting”.

mistakes.text: He waited for two hours {before|until} his number finally appeared.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Na trvanie pred iným minulým dejom sa lepšie hodí Past Perfect Continuous: „had been waiting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Na trvání před jiným minulým dějem se lépe hodí Past Perfect Continuous: „had been waiting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: To stress duration before another past event, the Past Perfect Continuous “had been waiting” fits better.

mistakes.text: He had waited for two hours {before|until} his number finally appeared.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dôraz je na trvaní čakania, preto je lepší Past Perfect Continuous: „had been waiting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Důraz je na trvání čekání, proto je lepší Past Perfect Continuous: „had been waiting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The focus is on how long he waited, so the Past Perfect Continuous “had been waiting” is better.

mistakes.text: He had been waiting since two hours {before|until} his number finally appeared.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri dĺžke trvania patrí „for“, nie „since“: „for two hours“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U délky trvání patří „for“, ne „since“: „for two hours“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Use “for” with a length of time, not “since”: “for two hours”.

mistakes.text: He has been waiting for two hours {before|until} his number finally appeared.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Číslo sa objavilo v minulosti, preto nie „has been“, ale „had been waiting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Číslo se objevilo v minulosti, proto ne „has been“, ale „had been waiting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The number appeared in the past, so not “has been” but “had been waiting”.
